wallpapers.title: Crafting continuity
wallpapers.caption: Native American Heritage Month
wallpapers.desc: A basket can carry far more than its contents. The Native American basketry seen here in Santa Fe, New Mexico, points to a much bigger story: a rich variety of techniques and designs developed by communities across the country. Their materials, patterns, and styles reflect their places of origin, turning everyday objects into records of local knowledge and identity.
